_about: Words the whole Court shares: conversation topics (what you ask, and answers any queen gives in her own voice), your pick-up lines, what queens say when they find you or leave (presence.lines) and what the Court notices (presence.notices), the town's rumors, and what a queen says about a sister, friend or rival (bondTalk). Add lines to any list; keep every key; only the {placeholders} listed in GROK_TALK.md.

ask: What have you been up to?
answer: Quiet, until you came. I spent it with {thing}.
Busy. {thing}, mostly. And wondering where you were.
Better now. The first half was all {thing}.
Long. But it ends with you, {pet}, so it's a good one.
{thing}. And, lately, someone who keeps reciting for me.
I love {thing}. Don't laugh.
Me? I'm simple. {thing}, {gift}, and a little attention.
What makes me happy? You keep showing up, {pet}.

ask: Do you think I'm getting better?
answer: {skill} at {level}. You tell me.
{total} levels, {pet}. Yes, you're getting better.
Better every time I see you. That's the whole trick.
Stronger than yesterday. That's all that counts.
{sister}? Family is complicated. I love her. Most days.
{sister} asked about you, actually. I said nothing. Much.
We argue, {sister} and I. Then we make up. Sisters.
{friend} is a dear. We talk about you more than you'd think.
{friend} thinks you're sweet. I think she's right.
{friend} and I go way back. She keeps me honest.
{foe}? Let's not ruin a good moment.
{foe} and I have history. Bad history.
Don't mention {foe}. Unless you want to see me jealous.
{place} is home. {thing} and quiet, mostly.
The best part of {place}? When you walk in.
I made {place} what it is. Ask anyone.
{gift}. Always {gift}.
You know what I like, {pet}. {gift}. Hint, hint.
Surprise me. But if it's {gift}, I won't complain.

ask: Do you ever think about the future?
answer: I dream of {thing}. Lately you're in it.
The future? More of this. More of you reciting.
I wish for one thing. I'll tell you at a higher tier.
“{phrase}”. Again. I like how you say it.
Say “{phrase}” a hundred times and it's yours forever.
Mm, “{phrase}”. Feed me that one sometime, {pet}.

ask: I came all this way to see you.
answer: Flattery. Keep going.
Do I miss you? Every time you walk off with someone else.
Careful, {pet}. I might start believing you.
I noticed. I always notice.

ask: What's something nobody knows about you?
Can you keep a secret? Can I?
answer: A secret? I practise my best smile for when you walk in.
Nobody knows I keep {thing} hidden for the hard days.
My secret is simple, {pet}: I look forward to you.
I once tried to recite your favourite phrase. “{phrase}”. I got it wrong twice.
Feed me words, {pet}. That's my favourite meal.
I'm always a little hungry when you're near. Funny, that.
Give me a hundred of “{phrase}” and I'll be full for a week.
Food? I'd rather have {gift}. And you, reciting.

pickupLines: Hey there, pretty mama. I recite, you swoon. Deal?
Is it hot in here, or is it just my Strength level?
They call me Alien X. Another word for handsome: also Alien X.
I just did a hundred reps. Of the alphabet. For you.
Do you believe in level-ups at first sight, or should I walk by again?
Whoa, mama! My Charisma just went up a whole level looking at you.
I memorise phrases for a living. Yours I will never forget.
Careful, baby. This much XP should come with a warning.
Are you a level-up? Because my heart just went ding.
I recited your name a hundred times. Still not tired of it.
If beauty were XP, you'd be level 99 in everything.
Do you have a map? I keep getting lost in your eyes.
I came for the XP. I stayed for you.
Every phrase I know, I'd trade for one smile from you.
My streak is perfect. Just like you.
I don't need the elixir. One look at you and I'm at double XP.
Some recite for gold. I recite for that look you just gave me.
I've been training all day. Mostly my courage, to talk to you.
Tell me your favourite phrase. I'll make it my next hundred reps.
Careful, your majesty. My Charisma is off the charts today.

seeking: There you are. I looked everywhere for you.
I couldn't wait any longer. I came to find you.
Don't look so surprised. I missed you, that's all.
I followed your footsteps all the way here.
Finally. I've been searching the whole region.
I had a feeling I'd find you here.
lonely: {hours} hours. Do you know how long that is?
I counted the hours. {hours} of them. Never again, promise?
{hours} hours alone. Don't do that to me again.
It's been {hours} hours. I started to think you forgot me.
confront: Don't pretend you didn't see me. Or her. {rival}, really?
I came all this way to ask you one thing: why {rival}?
Everyone's talking about you and {rival}. Is it true?
I'm not leaving until you tell me about {rival}.
present: {passes} passes for me so far. I count every one.
Your best streak was {streak}. I was watching. I'm always watching.
I just wanted to be near you.
Mind if I tag along? I won't be any trouble.
Your best streak is {streak}. Show me another?
leaveHappy: Come find me later. I'll be waiting.
That was lovely. I'll see you soon.
I'm going home with a smile, thanks to you.
Until next time. Don't keep me waiting.
leaveHurt: You didn't even look at me.
I came all this way for nothing.
I hope whoever you're thinking of is worth it.
Next time, maybe I won't come.

out: {queen} has come out looking for you.
{queen} is wandering the paths, looking for you.
{queen} slipped out of the {place}. She's looking for you.
outConfront: {queen} is coming for you, and she looks upset 💢
{queen} is marching your way, and she isn't smiling.
{queen} left in a hurry. Someone is in trouble.
leftHurt: {queen} went home hurt. You ignored her 💔
{queen} went home with her head down.
rivals: {queen} and {other} meet, over you. The air turns cold 💢
{queen} and {other} pass each other without a word. Both look at you.
{queen} and {other} glare at each other. You are standing right between them.
{queen} turns her back on {other}. Both glance at you.
close: {queen} and her {bond} {other} whisper about you and giggle ♥
{queen} stops to hug her {bond} {other}. They both look your way.
{queen} links arms with her {bond} {other}. They're talking about you.
{queen} and her {bond} {other} share a secret smile your way.

buzz: All the Court is talking about {queen} today. Everything you do for her counts ×{mult} ♥ until midnight.
The bards sing only of {queen} today. Win her now: ×{mult} ♥ until midnight.
{queen} is the talk of the town today, and she knows it. ×{mult} ♥ for her until midnight.
Every bard in town has a song about {queen} today. ×{mult} ♥ for her until midnight.
{queen} is the jewel of the day. Anything for her counts ×{mult} ♥ until midnight.
favored: A bard swears {queen} goes weak for anyone who is good at {skill}.
They say {queen} watches the {skill} lessons from her window every evening.
Word at the Inn: the way to {queen}'s heart is {skill}.
{queen} hums when someone practises {skill} under her window.
The fastest way to {queen}'s smile? Be good at {skill}.
gift: A merchant at the Moon Market says {queen} keeps every {gift} she is ever given.
Rumor has it {queen} once wept over a gift of {gift}.
{queen}'s maid let it slip: nothing makes her smile like {gift}.
{queen} keeps {gift} by her bed, they say.
If you want {queen} to blush, bring {gift}.
need: {queen} won't look twice at anyone under {need}. Some say she is waiting for you.
They say {queen} asks about you. Reach {need} and she might answer.
{queen} told the guards: anyone below {need} gets turned away.
{queen} is waiting for someone with {need}. It could be you.
wish: {queen} has been sighing all day. She wants {count} passes of {skill}.
A maid let it slip: {queen} hopes someone recites {skill} for her today.
{queen} keeps glancing at the training grounds. {count} passes of {skill}, she wants.
Word is {queen} will be over the moon for {count} passes of {skill} today.
stranger: {queen} asked the guards who you are.
{queen} pretended not to notice you today. She noticed.
{queen} asked the bard who you were. The bard didn't know either.
{queen} watched you cross the square today. Just for a moment.
fond: Someone saw {queen} writing your name in the margin of a book.
{queen} asked the bard to sing of you. Twice.
{queen} smiled at nothing all morning. The maids think it was you.
{queen} laughs a little louder when you're near, people say.
{queen} keeps a flower you dropped. She thinks nobody knows.
devoted: {queen} told the whole Court she is yours. Nobody dared to argue.
They say {queen} sleeps with your words under her pillow.
{queen} turned down a prince today. She said her heart is spoken for.
{queen} has your name embroidered on her sleeve.
{queen} lights a candle for you every night.
jealous: {queen} has been asking everyone where you spend your evenings.
{queen} threw a letter from {other} into the fire. Twice.
{queen} heard about you and {other}. Her halls are very quiet.
{queen} hasn't touched her supper since she saw you with {other}.
{queen} is asking the guards about {other}. Pointed questions.
longing: {queen} keeps looking at the door. It has been {hours} hours.
{queen} left a candle in her window for you. It has burned for {hours} hours.
{queen} has asked about you every hour. That's {hours} questions.
It's been {hours} hours. {queen} pretends she isn't counting.
bond: {queen} and her {bond} {other} talked about you until dawn.
{queen} told her {bond} {other} all about you. Now {other} wants to meet you.
{other} asked {queen} what you are like. {queen} blushed.
{queen} and her {bond} {other} have a bet about you.
{other} told {queen} you're the one. {queen} said she knew.
rival: {queen} and {other} are not speaking. Some say it is about you.
{queen} and {other} wore the same colour today. On purpose. For you.
A duel of glances at the Market: {queen} and {other}, over you.
{queen} and {other} both sent you flowers. Same day. Same hour.
{queen} says {other} is all talk. {other} says the same.
you: People say you reached {skill} {level}. The queens noticed.
Your name came up at the Inn: {reps} passes recited, and counting.
Children in the street play at being you, reciting {skill}.
The guards whisper about your {skill}. Level {level}, they say.
{reps} passes and counting. The whole Court knows your name.

sister: My sister {other} asks about you every day. I tell her nothing. Mostly.
{other} says you have kind eyes. My sister is never wrong.
Be good to {other} too. She's my sister, and she likes you.
{other} and I used to recite together as girls. You'd have liked it.
Don't tell {other} I said so, but she's the best of us.
My sister {other} thinks you're charming. She's right, for once.
{other} borrowed my favourite necklace again. Sisters.
friend: {other} told me about you. All good things, I promise.
My friend {other} says I smile more since you came.
If you see {other}, say I said hello. And that you're mine.
{other} and I had tea this morning. Guess who we talked about.
{other} is a dear. She says I should keep you.
My friend {other} wants to meet you properly. Should I let her?
{other} always knows how to cheer me up. So do you.
rival: If {other} smiles at you, don't smile back.
{other}? Please. You can do so much better.
I saw {other} looking at you. I didn't like it.
{other} thinks she's so special. She isn't.
If {other} invites you anywhere, say you're busy. With me.
{other} copied my hair again. Can you believe it?
I don't hate {other}. I just like you better than she does.
